children: Fulton Financial’s net interest income and earnings available to common shareholders increased year over year in the third quarter. Net interest income benefited from loan growth, including loans acquired in the Blue Foundry merger, and higher fee income; lower credit-loss provision also supported earnings, while noninterest expenses rose.
² Reported as “Net Income Available to Common Shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Net income available to common shareholders (diluted)”.
: 3.58%, up 1 basis point from the third quarter of 2025.
: Noninterest income rose 9.7% to $77.2M, led by wealth management, commercial banking and mortgage banking.
: Average net loans increased $2.0B, or 8.1%, primarily driven by $1.6B of loans acquired in the Blue Foundry merger.
: Non-accrual loans fell $10.4M, or 7.1%, during the quarter; provision for credit losses was $4.1M versus $10.2M a year earlier.
